lixpiValue: veoConfig.lastFrame, set at google-provider.ts:788 as the stop frame
summary: Pins the final frame of an interpolation request. It is invalid by itself and must be paired with the opening source image, so the two frames describe a transition rather than two independent references.
combines: Supported on all active Veo 3.1 models through the Gemini Developer API and Vertex.
Only valid together with the top-level `image`; it cannot be used alone.

usage.from: the first distinct state.videoReferenceImages entry after the opening frame
usage.what: Converts the second selected frame to Gemini image bytes, sends it in config.lastFrame, and forces an eight-second request.
